notes: CONFIRMED on price and shape. USD 45.00 a year / 12 = USD 3.75 a month, one payment of USD 45.00, for 4 cores / 8192 MB / 60 GB NVMe RAID-10 / 8 TB at 10 Gbps. This is the cheapest 8 GiB row in the band. The caveat is that the renewal is genuinely not published: 320,626 bytes of page contain no 'renew' and no 'recurring', and every card prices only 'Annually'. The incumbent record called it a 'clearance' price against a 'list USD 40/mo'; What is established is the annual charge and the absence of a published renewal. Treat month 13 as unknown rather than as USD 3.75. Stock is real and per-location: RO and CUK showed 8 available each, DE and NYC showed 0.
